facts_established: Cipher: 64-bit Feistel, 4 rounds. Encrypt: L=PL,R=PR; R^=L; rounds i=0..3: newR=L^F(R^K_i), newL=R; then L^=R; output=(R4,L4w) i.e. CL=R4, CR=L4^R4. Backward: R3=L4=CL^CR, R2=CL^F(R3^K3), F(R1^K1)=R2^R0, F(R2^K2)=R3^R1, F(R0^K0)=R1^PL so K0=Finv(R1^PL)^R0, K1=Finv(R2^R0)^R1, K2=Finv(R3^R1)^R2, K3=Finv(R4^R2)^R3

KEY INSIGHT: exact affine 8-bit channel. chi(T)=LSBs of 4 bytes, gam(T)=bits2 of 4 bytes. chi(F(T)) and gam(F(T)) depend ONLY on chi(T). Round: (chiL,gamL,chiR,gamR)->(chiR,gamR, chiL^chiF[chiR^kap_i], gamL^gamF[chiR^kap_i]). Init: chiL=chi(PL), gamL=gam(PL), chiR=chi(PR^PL), gamR=gam(PR^PL) — gam inits are NOT zero

Ciphertext prediction: chi(CL)=chi(R4)=cR after 4 rounds; chi(CR)=chi(L4^R4)=cL^cR. So kappa brute-force: cR4==chi(CL) && cL4^cR4==chi(CR) for pairs (8 bits/pair, 32 pairs = 256 bits, pins 16-bit kappa uniquely)
expand(seed)=seed^(seed<<16)^(seed*12345) mod 2^32, seed<2^20; kappa_i=chi(expand(s_i))

F bytes: x0=LSB..x3=MSB; y2=G(x3^x2,x1^x0,1); y3=G(x3,y2,0); y1=G(x1^x0,y2,0); y0=G(x0,y1,1). F is bijection; Finv: x3=ror2(y3)-y2; B=ror2(y1)-y2; A=ror2(y2)-B-1; x0=ror2(y0)-y1-1; x1=B^x0; x2=A^x3 (ror2(t)=(t>>2)|(t<<6), mod 256)

facts_established: KEY INSIGHT: cost_model.plan_metrics computes batch cost/pad/latency purely from the ACTUAL request prompt_len/gen_len in each batch (S_max=max align(prompt,64), G_max=max gen_len). Declared shapes ONLY affect: (a) compile cost = Kshape_attn*S^2 + Kshape_mlp*S*HIDDEN per unique declared shape (small), (b) the <=8 unique shapes cap, (c) validation (shape.seq_align must be >= aligned prompt of each request in batch; identical within batch_id). So declared shape can be a 'cap' >= S_max with no metric penalty.

Decode cost/latency per request depends only on batch (S_max, G_max) and is identical for all requests in batch. Per-request batches (or groups of requests with identical (S,G)) minimize cost, latency AND pad simultaneously. Grouping requests with same (align(prompt),gen_len) is free.
pad_prefill = sum(align(prompt,64)-prompt) is FIXED per request (independent of plan). pad_decode = sum(G_max - gen_len) -> 0 if batch by exact gen_len.

facts_established: check.py: run_solution strips last 2 fields per output line; our lines MUST be 6 fields 'board b castling ep 0 0'. Comparison: x in pythons4fieldset OR x.rpartition(' ')[0]+' -' in set (covers us-showing-spurious-ep). Castling field must match EXACTLY. python-chess 1.11.2 installed.

FINAL LAYOUT: mailbox 120 chars = 20 slashes + /rank8..rank1 rows (each '/'+8 cells+'/') + 20 slashes. cell(r,f)=100-10*r+f: a8=21,h8=28,e8=25,a1=91,e1=95,f1=96,g1=97,h1=98,b1=92,c1=93,d1=94. Internal line: board120|F1F2F3F4|EP|side; F1=white-K,F2=white-Q,F3=black-k,F4=black-q as +/-; EP = file letter or '0'; side 0=white parent,1=black child. Padding/borders are '/', empty cells are '.'.

Move rule templates: adjacent: (?m)^(.{i})M([destcls])(.{t})\|([+-])([+-])([+-])([+-])\|(.)\|0$ -> \g<0>\n\g<1>.M\g<3>|FLAGS|EP|1 (t=119-j). Slider: path group ((?:.{g}[.]){d-2}.{g}) g=|step|-1 (rank gap0,file 9,diag 8/10), destcls [pnbrq.]. Knights deltas ±8,±12,±19,±21. King dest [pnbrq.] (no k capture). Flags: K move clears F1F2; R@a1 clears F2; R@h1 clears F1; any move to a8 clears F4, to h8 clears F3 (safe: empty dest + right set impossible on clean inputs).

Pawns: pushes dest [.] r2-7 (r7->outchar Q); captures dest [pnbrq] df±1; double push P[..] sets EP=file letter; all else EP='-'. EP capture rules (2 orderings): df=-1: dst(6,tf)<bp(5,tf)<P(5,f), P adjacent after p: (.dst)[.](.9)pP(.t2) with ep flag=tf letter; df=+1: dst<P(5,f)<p(5,tf): (.dst)[.](.8)Pp(.t2). Rep clears bp and P squares, P->dst, EP '-', flags backref.

Child attack filters (delete (?m)^.*X.*
?): knights n.{7}K/K.{7}n/n.{11}K/K.{11}n/n.{18}K/K.{18}n/n.{20}K/K.{20}n; king kK/Kk/k.{8}K/K.{8}k/k.{9}K/K.{9}k/k.{10}K/K.{10}k; pawn p.{8}K/p.{10}K (black attacks +9/+11 only); sliders [rq][.]{0,6}K, K[.]{0,6}[rq], [rq](?:.{9}[.]){0,6}.{9}K + reverse, [qb] same with 8 and 10 gaps. Padding '/' blocks wraparounds. Parent deleted via (?m)^[^
]*\|0
? before filters.

Parse order: 15 castling literal rules (' KQkq '->' ++++ ' etc, longest first), ' w - '->' w ---- ', ' - ([0-9]+) '->' 0 \1 ' (ep dash), ' ([a-h])[0-9] '->' \1 ' (ep strip rank), digits 8..1 -> dots, ' w '->' 0 ', mailbox rule ^row/.../row 0 (\S+)(\S+) .*$ -> /x20/rows/x20|cast|ep|0. Then 4 clean-rights rules: (?m)^(?!.{95}K.{2}R)([^\n]*)\|([+-]) -> \1|- (and R@91+3+K for F2, k@25.{2}r for F3, r@21.{3}k for F4). Convert: extract ranks via ^/{20}/(C{8})x8/{21}(\|.+)$ -> \1/.../\8\9; dots 8..1 -> digits; 16 castling |++++|->|KQkq|...; ep rules |([KQkq-]+)|([a-h])|1$ -> ' b \1 \g<2>3 0 0' and |0|1$ -> ' b \1 - 0 0'.

Output bytes = base-255 digits of LO (m digits, little-endian collected then reversed), each +1 (so no 0x00 bytes). Decoder EOF byte reads 255->digit 254.
